summary: The "StudentPreSafety" document involves functionality for managing student prerequisites with respect to safety protocols. This includes actions on user controls, data binding, and handling prerequisite status updates.
purpose: To ensure that student safety prerequisites are properly managed, displayed, and editable on the user interface.

workflows.name: Manage Student Prerequisites
steps: Check if CRCStatus is not 'Unknown' and is not null to make the control visible.
Check if IDCard is not null to make the control visible.
Check if WCBWaiverDate is not null to make the control visible.
Translate fields based on language preference.
Switch to edit mode upon command.
Data bind the prerequisite details when details are available.
Update input parameters when data source is updating.
Setup JavaScript variables for client-side operations.

business_rules: Student prerequisites must be displayed only if applicable statuses are not unknown or null.
Translation of fields should respect alternate language settings.
validations: Ensure page is valid before proceeding with updates.
Insert a blank dropdown item for selection convenience.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines whether the save button is visible.
Based on the current mode, the command name of the button is set to 'Update' or 'Insert'.
system_behavior: Redirects to the 'Safety' page upon item update completion.
dependencies: JavaScript must be set for async operations if applicable.
